title: Assessing learning outcomes and self-directed learning through gamification in LMS
reason: Re-extraction (inclusion not re-decided). Single-group pre/post test (n = 35) plus descriptive SDL questionnaire and interviews; gamification activity records are never measured or correlated. Would fail I1-I4 (E4); Table 2 n and design are wrong; flagged.

extraction.design: pre-experimental, single-group pre/post test + SDL questionnaire (descriptive) + interviews
extraction.n_quote: This study employed a pre-experimental, single-group pre- and post-test design involving 35 Islamic
extraction.population: Islamic undergraduate students in an 'Intermediate English' course, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none measured; gamification elements (points, leaderboards, badges, progress trackers) were part of the intervention only
extraction.outcome_or_construct: learning-outcome test (pre/post); self-directed learning (Garrison-model questionnaire, self-report, post only, descriptive)
extraction.notes: Table 2 row is wrong: n is 35, not 60; design is single-group pre/post, not correlational; no 'gamification activity records' are analysed, so the manuscript's 'activity records correlate with self-directed-learning indicators' is unsupported. Statistics reported are within-group only: 'the Cohen’s d is calculated to be approximately 0.76' (pre-post change) and a pre-test ↔ post-test correlation of 0.624 (Table 2); neither is an indicator-outcome relation, so none is extracted. Internal inconsistency: means 71.62 -> 85.85 but 'mean difference of − 6.027'. Published in SSHO (the target journal).
